inputs.original_text: DHS said ICE arrested an illegal immigrant gang member after New York City authorities released him, despite him posing a danger to public safety. The department criticized the city, saying the case highlights tensions between sanctuary policies and federal immigration enforcement, as well as the potential public safety risks of releasing people with criminal records.
